sources.source: USDA SR Legacy 2018 + FNDDS 2021-2023 + Foundation 2026 + Nepal DFTQC 2012
Fruit records (Nepal DFTQC + USDA), supersedes data/fruits.js
Vegetable records (Nepal DFTQC + USDA), supersedes data/vegetables.js
USDA SR Legacy 2018, retained for index stability and backfill
USDA FDC nutrient id to name and unit

license: USDA: CC0 1.0 / Government of Nepal DFTQC Food Composition Table 2012
invariants: foods[i].id === i. Original data/foods.js rows keep indices 0..10332 so saved day-log entries still resolve to the same food.
Duplicates are merged, never removed, so Nepali names and micronutrients survive.
195 raw source categories are collapsed into 16 display groups.
notes: Values are per 100 g of the exact named food.
Missing values are null and shown as unknown, never zero.
Nepali names are search aliases, not a claim the food was measured in Nepal.
